title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models
paper_type_zh: 前沿推理与智能体模型报告和数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计合成 agentic 训练、GRPO、思考工具调用与开放权重背后的未公开数据和反馈边界
one_line: DeepSeek-V3.2 reports 85,267 agent prompts, 1,827 synthetic tool environments, specialist distillation, and mixed GRPO, while releasing model weights and inference code but not training records, environments, or reward artifacts.
DeepSeek-V3.2 报告 scalable GRPO、专家蒸馏以及覆盖 1,800+ 环境、85K+ 指令的合成 agentic 训练；数据、环境、奖励契约和审计资产未公开。
why: It lets the frontier-report track compare unusually specific task and feedback descriptions against the much narrower set of artifacts that can actually be downloaded and replayed.
inclusion_reason: A frontier disclosure with exact agent-task category counts, multiple environment and feedback contracts, specialist distillation, and a detailed scalable-GRPO design, paired with open weights but no open training data or replayable post-training stack.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports can disclose impressive reasoning and agent results while leaving the training objects inaccessible. DeepSeek-V3.2 is a particularly important disclosure case because its report gives exact counts for four agent-task categories, describes several construction and verification pipelines, and explains modifications for scaling GRPO. At the same time, the official release provides model weights and inference support rather than a post-training dataset or runnable training stack.

Four claims must therefore remain separate. First, the DeepSeek-V3.2 and DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale weights are downloadable. Second, encoding and inference code is downloadable. Third, the report describes how specialist distillation, cold-start examples, mixed RL, and agent-task synthesis were organized. Fourth, benchmark tables describe model behavior under stated and sometimes internal evaluation settings. None of these claims means that the prompts, trajectories, rewards, environments, or filtering decisions are available as data.

The audit object is a disclosure ledger, not a dataset card for a released corpus. It asks which prompts and episodes were produced, who or what generated them, which tools and verifiers supplied feedback, what entered SFT and RL, and which artifacts make those statements replayable. The report answers some questions at aggregate or method level, but record-level source lineage, complete mixture accounting, rejected candidates, rollout groups, environment snapshots, and rights remain unknown.

前沿模型报告可以充分披露推理与智能体成绩，却不开放实际训练对象。DeepSeek-V3.2 是一个重要案例：报告给出四类智能体任务的准确数量，描述多种构造与验证流程，也说明了用于扩展 GRPO 的改动；但官方发布提供的是模型权重与推理支持，而不是后训练数据集或可运行训练栈。

因此必须分开四类主张。第一，DeepSeek-V3.2 与 DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale 权重可下载；第二，编码与推理代码可下载；第三，报告说明专家蒸馏、冷启动样本、混合 RL 和智能体任务合成如何组织；第四，基准表反映模型在指定设置下的行为，其中部分使用内部评测环境。以上任何一项都不等于提示、轨迹、奖励、环境或筛选决策已经作为数据开放。

本 Card 的审计对象是披露账本，而不是已发布语料的数据卡。需要追问：生成了哪些提示和交互轨迹，生成者是谁，哪些工具与判定器提供反馈，哪些对象进入 SFT 和 RL，以及哪些工件能够重放这些陈述。报告在聚合或方法层回答了部分问题，但逐条来源、完整混合比例、被拒候选、rollout 组、环境快照与权利信息仍未知。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The post-training design has three connected layers. Specialist distillation first creates domain models from the same DeepSeek-V3.2 base for writing, general question answering, mathematics, programming, logical reasoning, general agents, coding agents, and search agents. The domains support reasoning and direct-response modes, and different generators produce long reasoning responses and direct answers. Their outputs are distilled into a common checkpoint, but the specialist identities, corpus sizes, acceptance rules, and row schema are not reported.

A cold-start layer joins existing non-agent reasoning data with non-reasoning tool-use data through task-specific control instructions and dedicated reasoning delimiters. The examples teach both direct tool calling and multiple calls inside a reasoning sequence. The report publishes a few illustrative templates, not the cold-start corpus. It explicitly notes that these early tool-use reasoning patterns can be fragile and mainly provide initial trajectories for later RL.

The final layer merges reasoning, agent, and human-alignment tasks into one GRPO stage. Reasoning and agent tasks receive rule-based outcome reward, a length penalty, and a language-consistency reward; general prompts use a generative reward model with prompt-specific rubrics. DeepSeek-V3.2 undergoes thousands of continued-RL steps. Speciale instead uses reasoning-only RL with a reduced length penalty and also incorporates DeepSeekMath-V2 data and reward methods. Thus the official model and Speciale encode different cost-versus-reasoning choices rather than being interchangeable releases.

后训练设计由三个相连层次组成。首先是专家蒸馏：所有专家都从同一个 DeepSeek-V3.2 基座出发，覆盖写作、通用问答、数学、编程、逻辑推理、通用智能体、代码智能体和搜索智能体。各领域同时支持推理与直接回答模式，不同生成者分别产出长推理响应和直接答案，再把结果蒸馏到统一检查点。不过，报告没有给出专家身份、语料规模、接受规则或逐行模式。

冷启动层通过任务特定的控制指令和专用推理分隔符，把已有的非智能体推理数据与不含推理过程的工具使用数据连接起来。样本同时教授直接工具调用和推理序列内的多次调用。报告只给出少量示例模板，没有发布冷启动语料；并且明确承认，这一阶段的工具推理模式可能不稳健，主要用于为后续 RL 提供初始轨迹。

最后一层把推理、智能体和人类对齐任务合并进同一个 GRPO 阶段。推理与智能体任务使用规则化结果奖励、长度惩罚和语言一致性奖励；通用提示则使用带逐提示评分细则的生成式奖励模型。DeepSeek-V3.2 继续进行数千步 RL。Speciale 改为只使用推理数据、降低长度惩罚，并加入 DeepSeekMath-V2 的数据与奖励方法。因此，正式版与 Speciale 代表不同的成本—推理权衡，不能视为同一发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
The base lineage begins at DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus with 128K context. A dense warm-up trains only the DSA indexer for 1,000 steps, 16 sequences of 128K tokens per step, totaling 2.1B tokens. Sparse continued pretraining then selects 2,048 key-value tokens per query and trains the full model plus indexer on 943.7B tokens. The report says both stages use the same data distribution as the V3.1-Terminus 128K extension, but does not identify that corpus, its sources, licenses, or decontamination.

Agent RL contains 85,267 prompts in Table 1: 24,667 code-agent tasks with real environments and extracted prompts; 50,275 search-agent tasks with real search tools and synthetic prompts; 4,417 general-agent tasks with synthetic environments and prompts; and 5,908 code-interpreter tasks with real Jupyter environments and extracted prompts. These are task counts, not trajectory counts. The number of attempts, retained episodes, reward records, and unique real environments is unknown.

Search synthesis samples long-tail web entities, constructs questions through search, generates heterogeneous candidate answers, and uses a search-enabled verification agent over multiple passes. It retains examples where the reference answer is validated and candidates are incorrect, then adds filtered helpful-RL prompts scored by a rubric-based generative reward model. Code-agent construction mines millions of GitHub issue–pull-request pairs, requires an issue description, correlated gold patch, and test patch, and uses an automated setup agent. A build passes only when the gold patch changes at least one target test from failure to pass and causes no previously passing test to fail, with JUnit output used across languages.

General-agent synthesis builds a sandbox database, task-specific function tools, a task, a solution function, and a Python verification function. The solution may use only tools or logic, not direct database access; the generator iteratively raises task difficulty and expands the toolset. After RL trials, only tasks with non-zero pass@100 remain, yielding 1,827 environments and 4,417 tasks. Code-interpreter tasks cover mathematics, logic, and data science through Jupyter, but their sources, filters, and counts before retention are not detailed.

Scaling GRPO changes the optimizer contract: an importance-weighted estimator corrects KL bias; highly divergent negative sequences are masked; MoE routing selected during sampling is reused during training; and the top-p or top-k sampling mask is preserved so sampling and update action spaces match. The equations are public, but the deployed group size, reward weights, thresholds, optimizer values, batch sizes, and rollout ledger are not.

模型谱系从具有 128K 上下文的 DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus 开始。密集预热阶段只训练 DSA 索引器，共 1,000 步，每步 16 个 128K token 序列，总计 2.1B token。随后稀疏继续预训练为每个查询选择 2,048 个键值 token，并用 943.7B token 联合训练主模型和索引器。报告称两个阶段的数据分布与 V3.1-Terminus 的 128K 扩展一致，但没有说明语料来源、许可或去污染情况。

表 1 的智能体 RL 共包含 85,267 个提示：代码智能体 24,667 个，使用真实环境和抽取提示；搜索智能体 50,275 个，使用真实搜索工具和合成提示；通用智能体 4,417 个，环境与提示均为合成；代码解释器 5,908 个，使用真实 Jupyter 环境和抽取提示。这些是任务数，不是轨迹数；尝试次数、保留轨迹、奖励记录和真实环境唯一数量均未知。

搜索合成先从网页语料中采样长尾实体，通过搜索构造问题，再由不同配置生成候选答案，并由具有搜索能力的验证智能体进行多轮检查。只保留参考答案经确认且候选答案错误的样本，随后加入经过筛选的 helpful-RL 提示，并由带评分细则的生成式奖励模型打分。代码智能体构造从数百万 GitHub 问题—拉取请求对中挖掘，要求问题描述、相关金补丁与测试补丁齐全，再由自动搭建智能体构建环境。只有应用金补丁后至少一个目标测试由失败变为通过、且没有原本通过的测试变为失败，环境才算成功；不同语言与测试框架统一解析 JUnit 输出。

通用智能体合成会建立沙箱数据库、任务特定函数工具、任务、解答函数和 Python 验证函数。解答只能通过工具或逻辑计算，不能直接访问数据库；生成者逐步提高难度，并在需要时扩充工具集。经过 RL 尝试后，仅保留 pass@100 非零的任务，得到 1,827 个环境和 4,417 个任务。代码解释器任务通过 Jupyter 覆盖数学、逻辑和数据科学，但其来源、筛选方式和筛选前规模没有详细披露。

Scaling GRPO 修改了优化契约：使用重要性加权估计纠正 KL 偏差；屏蔽策略偏离过大的负优势序列；训练时复用采样阶段选择的 MoE 路由；保留 top-p 或 top-k 采样掩码，使采样和更新的动作空间一致。论文公开了公式，但实际组大小、奖励权重、阈值、优化器参数、批量规模和 rollout 账本均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest data evidence is the task accounting and the distinct verifier descriptions. The four agent categories sum exactly to 85,267 prompts, and the general-agent branch gives both 1,827 synthetic environments and 4,417 retained tasks. The code branch reports tens of thousands of multilingual executable issue-resolution environments, while its table gives 24,667 tasks. The discrepancy is not necessarily contradictory, but the report does not publish an environment-to-task manifest.

The report tests 50 random general synthetic tasks. DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp obtains 12% Pass@1 and the strongest listed closed model obtains 62%; higher Pass@K increases all scores. This is evidence that the sampled tasks are not trivial to those models, not evidence that all 4,417 tasks are realistic, correctly verified, uncontaminated, or legally reusable. A separate ablation applies non-reasoning RL only to synthetic general-agent tasks and reports improvements over the SFT checkpoint on Tau2Bench, MCP-Mark, and MCP-Universe. That supports transfer under the reported setup, not record-level quality.

Model evaluations provide a fourth, separate evidence layer. The report gives reasoning, code, search, and tool-use scores, but MCP-Universe and MCP-Mark use internal environments that may differ from official ones. Tool-use evaluations use temperature 1.0 and 128K context. BrowseComp rises from 51.4 without context management to 67.6 with a discard-all strategy, showing that inference scaffolding materially affects the score. The primary SWE-bench result also comes from an internal framework, though additional frameworks produce a 72–74 range.

Official artifacts verify openness only for deployment. Hugging Face revision a7e62ac04ecb2c0a54d736dc46601c5606cf10a6 hosts DeepSeek-V3.2 weights, encoding and inference code, the paper, and selected olympiad submissions under MIT. Speciale is separately hosted at revision c562883eda916fd699a44bbf1f4987a53b96008b. The GitHub DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp repository at commit 87e509a2e5a100d221c97df52c6e8be7835f0057 contains inference files, not post-training code. No official V3.2 dataset appears under the DeepSeek-AI Hugging Face account.

最强的数据证据来自任务账本与不同判定器的说明。四类智能体任务准确合计为 85,267 个提示；通用智能体分支同时给出 1,827 个合成环境和 4,417 个保留任务。代码分支称构建了数万个多语言可执行问题修复环境，而表中给出 24,667 个任务。两者未必矛盾，但报告没有发布环境—任务映射清单。

报告从通用合成任务中随机抽取 50 个进行测试。DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp 的 Pass@1 为 12%，所列最强闭源模型为 62%，各模型在更高 Pass@K 下分数上升。这只能证明该小样本对这些模型并不简单，不能证明全部 4,417 个任务都现实、验证正确、无污染或可合法复用。另一项消融仅在通用合成任务上进行非推理模式 RL，并报告相对 SFT 检查点在 Tau2Bench、MCP-Mark 与 MCP-Universe 上提升。这支持所述设置下的迁移效果，但不是逐条质量证据。

模型评测构成第四个独立证据层。报告给出推理、代码、搜索和工具使用分数，但 MCP-Universe 与 MCP-Mark 使用可能不同于官方版本的内部环境。工具评测使用温度 1.0 和 128K 上下文。BrowseComp 从无上下文管理时的 51.4 提升到 discard-all 策略下的 67.6，说明推理脚手架会实质改变分数。SWE-bench 主结果也来自内部框架，虽然其他框架给出了 72–74 的区间。

官方工件只验证了部署层开放。Hugging Face 修订 a7e62ac04ecb2c0a54d736dc46601c5606cf10a6 以 MIT 提供 DeepSeek-V3.2 权重、编码与推理代码、论文和部分奥赛提交；Speciale 单独位于修订 c562883eda916fd699a44bbf1f4987a53b96008b。GitHub DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp 仓库在提交 87e509a2e5a100d221c97df52c6e8be7835f0057 下包含推理文件，而非后训练代码。DeepSeek-AI 的 Hugging Face 账号下没有发现官方 V3.2 数据集。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For a frontier disclosure ledger, the notable contribution is the unusual specificity of the agent-task layer. The report does not merely say that synthetic tool data were used: it separates real and synthetic environments, extracted and synthetic prompts, four task families, exact prompt counts, and family-specific feedback. Search combines evidence gathering, adversarial candidate generation, verification, and rubric scoring. Code repair defines an executable gold-patch contract. General agents co-synthesize databases, tools, tasks, solutions, and verifiers.

The report also connects data design to optimization stability. Specialist distillation supplies both reasoning and direct-response behavior; cold-start examples introduce multi-call tool use; mixed RL combines rule-based and model-based feedback; and Scaling GRPO addresses KL estimation, off-policy samples, MoE routing mismatch, and truncated sampling. This is a richer report-level construction account than a benchmark-only model card.

A second useful idea is reasoning persistence around tools. Reasoning state is kept when only tool outputs are appended, but discarded when a new user message arrives, while tool-call history remains. The design reduces repeated re-derivation across calls, though it interacts poorly with frameworks that encode tool events as user messages. This makes the conversation-role convention part of the effective environment contract.

The novelty stops at disclosure. The 85K prompt ledger, illustrative templates, equations, model weights, and inference code do not expose the actual SFT records, policy episodes, rewards, environment packages, training implementation, or acceptance ledger. The Card therefore treats these mechanisms as reported design, not a reusable open recipe.

对于前沿披露账本，最值得关注的是智能体任务层的具体程度。报告不只笼统声称使用了合成工具数据，而是区分真实与合成环境、抽取与合成提示、四类任务、准确提示数量和各类反馈。搜索任务结合证据收集、对抗性候选生成、验证与评分细则；代码修复定义可执行的金补丁契约；通用智能体共同合成数据库、工具、任务、解答和判定器。

报告还把数据设计连接到优化稳定性。专家蒸馏提供推理与直接回答行为；冷启动样本引入多次工具调用；混合 RL 结合规则反馈和模型反馈；Scaling GRPO 处理 KL 估计、离策略样本、MoE 路由不一致与截断采样。这比只给基准表的模型卡提供了更丰富的报告级构造说明。

另一个有用设计是围绕工具调用保留推理状态。若只追加工具结果，则保留此前推理；若出现新用户消息，则移除推理内容，但工具调用历史仍保留。该设计减少多轮调用中的重复推导，却与把工具事件编码为用户消息的框架不完全兼容。因此，会话角色约定本身也成为有效环境契约的一部分。

创新边界仍停留在披露层。85K 提示账本、示例模板、公式、模型权重和推理代码都没有公开实际 SFT 记录、策略轨迹、奖励、环境包、训练实现或接受账本。因此，本 Card 把这些机制视为报告中的设计，而不是可复用开放配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Training-data disclosure is incomplete at every major stage. Continued pretraining gives token totals and says its distribution matches V3.1-Terminus, but omits corpus composition, dates, licenses, quality filters, and decontamination. Specialist distillation names domains and response modes but not specialists, prompt counts, generated counts, acceptance rates, direct-versus-reasoning mixture, or final SFT membership. Mixed RL gives reward families and thousands of steps but no prompt mixture, rollout group size, sampled outputs, reward values, rejected sequences, or checkpoint schedule.

Agent environments are described but not released. Search depends on commercial or real web APIs and a search-enabled verifier whose queries, sources, passes, and calibration are absent. Code repair depends on mined GitHub issues, patches, test patches, automated dependency setup, and JUnit parsing; source URLs, commits, containers, logs, failure rates, and licenses are unavailable. General environments include generated databases, function tools, solutions, and verification functions, yet none of those 1,827 packages can be inspected for shortcuts or correlated generator errors.

Several filters establish narrow predicates rather than overall quality. Gold-patch F2P/P2F checks validate a code environment, not the issue description or the model's unseen repair. Non-zero pass@100 removes tasks never solved by the training model, but can favor exploitable verifiers and does not show unique solutions. A search verifier and generative rubrics can inherit factual, calibration, and preference errors. No false-accept audit or retained/rejected ledger is reported.

Evaluation reproducibility is also limited. Some benchmarks use internal environments; search results depend on context management; conversation-role conventions change whether reasoning persists; and long repeated verification can exceed 128K. Speciale spends substantially more output tokens and lacks tool calling, so its olympiad results should not be attributed to the deployable V3.2 tool model. Released competition submissions enable narrow secondary checks, not audit of training data.

Finally, MIT applies to official weights and inference repositories, not automatically to web-derived prompts, GitHub issues or patches, helpful-RL data, synthetic databases, generated episodes, or evaluator inputs. The report states that test tools were unseen during agent RL, but no match ledger or broader contamination analysis is available. Benchmark performance cannot resolve these provenance, rights, or verifier gaps.

所有主要训练阶段的数据披露都不完整。继续预训练给出 token 总量，并称数据分布与 V3.1-Terminus 相同，却没有说明语料构成、时间、许可、质量筛选和去污染。专家蒸馏只列出领域与响应模式，没有给出专家身份、提示数量、生成数量、接受率、直接回答与推理比例或最终 SFT 归属。混合 RL 给出奖励类型和数千步训练，却没有提示混合、rollout 组大小、采样输出、奖励值、被拒序列或检查点调度。

智能体环境只被描述，没有发布。搜索依赖商业或真实网页 API，以及未公开查询、来源、验证轮数和校准情况的搜索判定智能体。代码修复依赖挖掘的 GitHub 问题、补丁、测试补丁、自动依赖搭建与 JUnit 解析，但源 URL、提交、容器、日志、失败率和许可不可获得。通用环境包含生成的数据库、函数工具、解答与验证函数，但 1,827 个环境包均无法检查是否存在捷径或相关生成错误。

多种筛选只建立狭窄判据，不能代表整体质量。金补丁的 F2P/P2F 检查验证的是代码环境，不是问题描述或模型尚未产生的修复。pass@100 非零会删除训练模型从未解决的任务，却可能偏向可利用判定器的样本，也不能证明解答唯一。搜索判定器和生成式评分细则会继承事实、校准与偏好误差；报告没有误接受审计或保留/拒绝账本。

评测复现也受限制。部分基准使用内部环境；搜索结果依赖上下文管理；会话角色约定会改变推理是否保留；重复验证会让轨迹超过 128K。Speciale 使用明显更多输出 token 且不支持工具调用，因此其奥赛结果不能归因于可部署的 V3.2 工具模型。已发布竞赛提交只支持有限的二次核验，不能审计训练数据。

最后，MIT 适用于官方权重与推理仓库，并不会自动覆盖网页提示、GitHub 问题或补丁、helpful-RL 数据、合成数据库、生成轨迹或评测输入。报告称智能体 RL 未见过测试工具，但没有匹配清单或更广泛污染分析。基准成绩无法填补来源、权利或判定器证据缺口。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger, this Card is useful precisely because the disclosure is asymmetric. It offers more task-construction detail than many frontier reports while releasing less training data than Llama-Nemotron. Auditors can compare the exact 85,267-prompt table, verifier descriptions, and Scaling GRPO equations against the absence of row files, environment packages, reward artifacts, and training configurations.

The report supplies patterns worth reproducing independently: report prompt counts by source and environment type; define a code-environment success predicate with target recoveries and regression protection; restrict synthetic solution functions from bypassing tools; co-evolve task difficulty with tool coverage; retain conversation-role semantics when reasoning spans tool calls; and preserve sampled routing and truncation masks during off-policy MoE updates. These are design lessons, not reusable data assets.

A credible reproduction manifest would need immutable source records, prompt and episode schemas, specialist checkpoints, generator versions, all candidates, acceptance reasons, environment containers, API versions, verification functions, reward-model checkpoints and rubrics, per-component rewards, policy probabilities, routing and sampling masks, optimizer values, and stage-to-checkpoint membership. It should separately account for SFT, reasoning RL, agent RL, and alignment RL.

Open weights are useful for inference research, behavior audits, quantization, deployment, and secondary checks of released olympiad submissions. They do not support reconstruction of the training corpus. Benchmark users should pin the weight revision and evaluation harness, report whether context management is used, and avoid treating score or task difficulty as evidence of data quality. Until the missing artifacts appear, this entry belongs in the frontier disclosure track rather than the open-release recipe track.

对于 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger，本 Card 的价值恰恰来自不对称披露：它比许多前沿报告提供更多任务构造细节，却比 Llama-Nemotron 开放更少训练数据。审计者可以把准确的 85,267 提示表、判定器描述和 Scaling GRPO 公式，与缺失的逐行文件、环境包、奖励工件和训练配置直接对照。

报告提供了值得独立复现的设计模式：按提示来源和环境类型报告数量；用目标测试恢复与回归保护定义代码环境成功判据；禁止合成解答函数绕过工具；随工具覆盖共同提高任务难度；在跨工具调用保留推理时维护会话角色语义；在离策略 MoE 更新中保留采样路由与截断掩码。这些是设计经验，不是可复用数据资产。

可信复现清单需要包括不可变源记录、提示与轨迹模式、专家检查点、生成器版本、全部候选、接受原因、环境容器、API 版本、验证函数、奖励模型检查点与评分细则、各奖励分量、策略概率、路由与采样掩码、优化器参数，以及阶段到检查点的归属；并应分别统计 SFT、推理 RL、智能体 RL 和对齐 RL。

开放权重可用于推理研究、行为审计、量化、部署和已发布奥赛提交的二次核验，但不能重建训练语料。基准使用者应固定权重修订与评测框架，说明是否启用上下文管理，并避免把分数或任务难度当作数据质量证据。在缺失工件补齐之前，本条目属于前沿披露赛道，而不是开放发布配方赛道。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep four ledgers separate: continued-pretraining and post-training data disclosure, SFT and RL methods, downloadable weights and inference code, and benchmark behavior.
  • Read Table 1 as 85,267 prompts across four task families; only the general branch gives 1,827 synthetic environments, and no trajectory count or downloadable task manifest is provided.
  • Match each branch to its own feedback: search verification plus rubrics, code F2P/P2F tests, general Python verification plus non-zero pass@100, and mixed-RL outcome, length, language, or generative rewards.
  • Pin final weight revision a7e62ac..., Speciale revision c562883..., and inference commit 87e509a...; none contains the missing SFT corpus, rollouts, reward history, or environment bundles.
  • Treat internal evaluation environments, context management, 128K truncation, and Speciale's larger token budget as score conditions; benchmarks do not certify data provenance or quality.

• 分开维护四本账：继续预训练与后训练数据披露、SFT 与 RL 方法、可下载权重与推理代码，以及基准行为。
  • 表 1 是四类任务合计 85,267 个提示；只有通用分支给出 1,827 个合成环境，没有轨迹数量或可下载任务清单。
  • 将每个分支对应到自己的反馈：搜索验证与评分细则、代码 F2P/P2F 测试、通用 Python 验证与 pass@100 非零，以及混合 RL 的结果、长度、语言或生成式奖励。
  • 固定正式权重修订 a7e62ac...、Speciale 修订 c562883... 和推理提交 87e509a...；它们都不包含缺失的 SFT 语料、rollout、奖励历史或环境包。
  • 把内部评测环境、上下文管理、128K 截断和 Speciale 的更大 token 预算视为分数条件；基准不能证明数据来源或质量。

items: No official V3.2 training dataset, task manifest, trajectory corpus, environment bundle, reward model, or training configuration is released.
The 85,267 task count describes prompts by category, not retained trajectories, rollout groups, reward records, or unique executable environments.
Search verification and prompt-specific generative rubrics depend on unreleased model judgments and calibration.
Code-environment success under a gold patch establishes test executability but not issue realism, license compatibility, or absence of leakage.
General tasks are co-synthesized with tools, solutions, and verifiers; correlated bugs or verifier shortcuts can survive non-zero pass@100 filtering.
Tool-use reasoning often repeats verification until trajectories exceed the 128K context limit; context management materially changes reported search results.
Several agent benchmarks use internal environments that may differ from official setups, limiting independent score reproduction.
Open weights and benchmark performance do not establish training-data provenance, verifier accuracy, or record-level quality.
未发布官方 V3.2 训练数据集、任务清单、轨迹语料、环境包、奖励模型或训练配置。

搜索验证与提示特定的生成式评分标准依赖于未发布的模型评判与校准。
gold patch 下的代码环境成功确立测试可执行性，但不确立 issue 真实性、许可兼容性或无泄漏。
一般任务与工具、解答和验证器共同合成；相关缺陷或验证器捷径可通过非零 pass@100 过滤而幸存。

若干智能体基准使用可能与官方设置不同的内部环境，限制独立分数复现。
开放权重与基准性能并不能确立训练数据谱系、验证器准确性或记录级质量。
